name: DeFleur Video (Testing)
short_desc: Service: Hermes-operated vertical-video editor running James DeFleur's full workflow (cuts, crops, motion graphics, captions).
author: Humanity Labs; workflow contract informed by Wizard Modules
description: Testing release. Hermes drives it over MCP; no browser UI and no LLM calls. Put your video in the Files app (Files → Videos), then tell Hermes the file name; the finished video is saved to Files → Videos → Edited. Bundles James DeFleur's DeFleur Video helpers and runs his whole workflow: import (20 min, up to 4K, iPhone .mov/HDR converted, edited at 1080p), speech-to-text via the Transcriber app, local alignment, sample-exact cuts with evidence and the dialogue gate, fixed per-setup face crops, optional HTML/SVG/GSAP motion graphics captured in the shared Browser app, burned captions, his 1080x1920 encode and delivery gate. Upload links remain as a fallback. No token needed: keep it on your private network (e.g. Tailscale).

form_fields.label: Transcriber URL
form_fields.hint: Where the Transcriber app answers inside Runtipi. Leave the default if the Transcriber app is installed on this same server.

form_fields.label: Browser address (for motion graphics)
form_fields.hint: Where the shared Browser app answers inside Runtipi (DevTools port 9222 on the Runtipi network; the Browser app's own Runtipi port is 8793, loopback only). Only motion graphics need it; plain captioned renders work without it.

form_fields.label: Transcriber model
form_fields.hint: Must already be downloaded in the Transcriber app (its startup model).
